{{Quote|That rotten Skywalker kid loused my reputation! Someone oughtta fix 'im...|translated=1|Ark "Bumpy" Roose|<ref name="Podracing Tales">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>}}
'''Ark Roose''', sometimes known by the nickname '''"Bumpy"''', was a particularly dim-witted [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who cared little for specialized tactics and maneuvers&mdash;his strategy on the track was simply to smash into whoever was nearby. A native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sump/Legends|Sump]], the world's sectarian government disapproved of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] pilot, though they permitted Roose to race offworld only in a half-hearted hope that he might somehow improve the image of Nuknogs. Ark Roose actually performed fairly well in the Podracing circuits, despite his aggressive strategies that otherwise seemed counter-intuitive to the speed-centered sport. Roose notably performed well on the [[Water/Legends|watery]] world of [[Aquilaris]]. He was also a fairly common sight on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where Roose became familiar with a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] pilot named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

Ark Roose was nearly bested by Skywalker during a race once, and even though Roose came out ahead, his near loss to a Human [[Youngling/Legends|child]] turned him into a laughing stock, thus creating in Ark Roose a thirst for revenge. During [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Roose was finally granted the chance to exact revenge on Skywalker after being hired by the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Diva Funquita/Legends|Diva Funquita]]. Gardulla believed Skywalker could be detrimental to her betting, and as such Roose set out to sabotage Skywalker's [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] before the start of the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. However, unfamiliar with Skywalker's pod, Roose unintentionally sabotaged [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]' podracer. Due to the mistake, Skywalker bested Roose in full during the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta race]] by winning the race outright. Roose on the other hand never finished, having become a victim of the equally rowdy pilot [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]]. Roose ended up recovering in a [[Mos Espa Medical Center|Mos Espa med center]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|I've never seen ''that'' Podracer before, and it sure looks pretty junky to me.|Ark "Bumpy" Roose, spotting Ben Quadinaros Podracer|<ref name="Podracing Tales" />}}
[[File:ArkRoose.png|thumb|left|150px|Ark Roose in full racing regalia]]
Hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sump/Legends|Sump]], the dim-witted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] named Ark Roose made his way from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and went out into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] circuits, despite the wishes of the Sump government. Purchasing a massive [[Vokoff-Strood/Legends|Vokoff-Strood]] [[Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array engine|Plug-G 927]] with a cluster array styled [[Engine/Legends|engine]], the vehicle could dominate the straightaways due to high end acceleration, and when upgraded, a top quality high speed. However, the vehicle was lackluster when it came to handling, thus making it difficult on sharper courses. However, Roose still managed to add some fame to his name by excelling at a course on the [[Water/Legends|water]] covered world of [[Aquilaris]] known as [[Bumpy's Breakers]], a course that got it's name from the rough turns and harsh obstacles. At some point during his career, Ark Roose gained the nickname of "Bumpy" himself, and became professionally known as such since. Roose often showed little control over his vehicle, and due to his hot desire to keep the lead once attained, he took anyone trying to pass him as a personal offence. These traits made Roose an unpredictable and dangerous [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] on the course. Roose eventually took his career to the Outer Rim world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During a race there, he was nearly overtaken and beaten by the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Roose managed to take back the lead, but found that his near defeat had suddenly turned him and his career into a laughing stock. Furious and paranoid that Skywalker may beat him out in the future, Roose held onto a tight grudge against the young boy.

===Boonta Race===
{{Quote|The boy. Stinking Human ''boy''.|Ark "Bumpy" Roose, lamenting|<ref name="Episode I: The Phantom Menace ½">[[Episode I: The Phantom Menace ½|''Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' ½]]</ref>}}
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], right before the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on Tatooine, Roose generally found himself drinking his anger away while wondering why no one had tried to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] Skywalker yet. However, having wondered these thoughts aloud after being harassed by the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] pilot [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], Roose's complaints were overheard by [[Diva Funquita/Legends|Diva Funquita]]. Diva Funquita was both a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and had been tasked by Gardulla to find a way to bring an end to Skywalker as she sorted her bets out with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Ark Roose eagerly accepted Funquita's bribe to sabotage Skywalker, and followed up by mistakenly drinking cleaning fluid. Ark Roose made his way to the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, but had difficulty in identifying which Pod was Skywalker's. Roose eventually found Sebulba, who was busy sabotaging [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo's]] Podracer, and asked the Dug if he knew what Skywalker's Pod looked like. Sebulba brushed Roose off, unhelpfully noting that it probably looked like a piece of junk. Roose spotted [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]' [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310 quadra-Podracer]], and having never seen it before and believing it to be in a state of disrepair, Roose sabotaged it, rigging it so it wouldn't accelerate. Believing he had accomplished his job, Roose began to make his own preparations for the Boonta.

[[File:Roose_Sabo-tore.png|thumb|right|225px|Ark Roose sabotaged Ben Quadinaros' Podracer, albeit by mistake.]]
Ark Roose started in the fourth row on the outside, and was given a hearty introduction from the [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] race announcer [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]. Upon his introduction, a [[Band/Legends|band]] began playing from the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] grand stands and Roose cheerfully waved back before entering his pod. When the race began the contestants burst from the grid and into the track with the exception of two&mdash;Anakin Skywalker and Ben Quadinaros. Skywalker however was able to move his pod into the race shortly after, whereas Ben's podracer, due to Roose's tampering, ended up losing control of the engines when the [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] failed. Roose managed to stay near the front of the pack for most of the race and navigated the course well, and even managed to avoid being destroyed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] who had camped out on one of the turns. However, at the beginning of the second lap, Roose needed to make a pit-stop where his [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] team administered the maintenance that was needed before Roose could speed off again. Conversely, the pilot [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] also stopped into the pits, but his left engine was destroyed when a Pit Droid was sucked into the engine's intake.

Near the end of the second lap, Roose's nemesis, Skywalker, zoomed past him to take place behind Sebulba, who had for the majority of the race kept the lead. Sebulba and Skywalker, enemies in their own right, dueled each other for the remainder of the race. However, as Roose began to make his way through a part of the track known as [[The Coil/Legends|The Coil]], Sebulba's in-race [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]], slammed into his podracer. "Bumpy" ended up biting the dust, but managed to take Bolt down with him, becoming one of the last wrecks in the race. Ark Roose and Dud Bolt were both recovered shortly thereafter and were taken to the [[Mos Espa Medical Center|Mos Espa med center]] to recover. As it turned out, Skywalker won the race entirely.

===Later years===
By coincidence, Roose was present on the same transport that carried [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to Tatooine. He did not recognize them, but Roose's conversation with an unnamed [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] gave Kenobi the idea of adopting "Ben" as an alias.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I think Ark "Bumpy" Roose is the one to watch today. He ''really'' wants to win.|Beed Annodue|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Ark_Roose_Waving_like_a_Champ.png|thumb|left|175px|Ark Roose waves to his fans]]
Ark Roose was a paranoid individual who for a time believed Anakin Skywalker was out to get him. However, the feeling was in no way unusual, as Roose was known to take offense at anyone who tried to overtake him. Even though Skywalker was only a child at the time, Roose was not above searching for a way to bring about Skywalker's demise, though he never came upon the idea of doing it himself until he was hired to do so by Diva Funquita. Roose was generally aggressive on the track towards Anakin Skywalker anyways. Despite such, Roose was a scatterbrained dim-wit, and on one occasion was referred to as a lunkhead, an insult which he hotly detested. Roose wasn't even particularly liked by his own homeworld, who only half-heartedly hoped he could improve the image of Nuknogs by performing well. As it turned out, Roose, as dim-witted as he was, was a fairly skilled pilot. Ark Roose had skin that was a deep [[Color/Legends|purple]] in color, and small yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Standing at 1.63 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, he was much taller than any of the other Boonta contestants, with the exception of Ben Quadinaros, who matched in height.

==Skills and abilities==
[[File:Ark_Roose_plots.png|thumb|right|175px|Roose plots to ruin Anakin Skywalker]]
Ark Roose's idea of a Podrace was nothing more than ramming into the competition as hard as he could in order to clear a path for himself. However, Roose could perform well on occasion, as proven by his successes on Aquilaris and Tatooine. Roose performed well during the Boonta Eve Classic as well, avoiding many of the obstacles that destroyed other pilots, his reflexes keeping him on his toes at each hairpin turn. As it turned out, Roose was not demolished by the course, and was instead wiped out by another pilot. Roose also scored record time on Aquilaris, proving that his aggressive racing style was not without merit. The Nuknog was a fairly adept mechanic, and knew how to disable Podracers. When assigned to sabotage Anakin Skywalker's Podracer, however, Roose, as opposed to doing any real research, simply wrecked the ugliest and most unfamiliar Podracer he could find, which happened to be the rented Podracer owned by Ben Quadinaros.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You'll end up womp rat food.|Ark Roose was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]]|translated=1|audio=ArkRoose-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer" />}}
[[File:Ark_Roose_Concept_Crop.png|thumb|right|125px|Concept art]]
Ark Roose first appeared in the [[1999]] novel [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'']] written by [[Terry Brooks]], based on the 1999 [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|film of the same name]].<ref name="TPMnovel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> While a detailed sculpture was created, Roose appeared as a low res digital model for medium and and distance shots. The basic model was later re-used in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] for the character [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]] and several other background Nuknogs. A more detailed version of Ark Roose's digital model was created for closeups included on ''The Phantom menace'' DVD. Much of Roose's history and background was revealed in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars comic books|web-comic]] ''[[Podracing Tales]]'', published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="Podracing Tales" /> Roose also appeared in the 1999 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' as a playable character, though in-game he was much shorter than his film appearance.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer" /> This short-stature version of Roose appeared again in the [[2012]] [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] video game [[Kinect Star Wars]]. In ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'', Ark "Bumpy" Roose's name is misspelled as Ark "Bumpy" Rose.
